summariesJSON.title: Page 1
summariesJSON.content: Page 1 provides an overview of photosynthesis. It defines photosynthesis as the process where green plants, algae, and some bacteria convert light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose. The overall chemical equation for photosynthesis is presented as 6CO₂ + 6H₂O + light energy → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂. Additionally, it specifies that photosynthesis occurs in the chloroplasts, particularly in the thylakoid membranes and the stroma.
